info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Regulatory Compliance Status API
info.description: The Regulatory Compliance Status API provides insights into the current compliance status of banking operations concerning regulatory requirements. This endpoint allows users to retrieve real-time updates on compliance checks and statuses that impact financial institutions. Typically used by compliance officers, auditors, and risk management teams, this API enables efficient reporting and decision-making regarding adherence to regulatory frameworks. Integration with this service helps ensure that organizations maintain compliance and manage risk effectively.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of regulatory compliance.
get.description: Use this endpoint to fetch the current status of regulatory compliance efforts. This information can help organizations understand their compliance standing and identify areas that may require attention.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching the compliance status related to regulatory compliance. The data provided will dictate the requested parameters and structure for the response.

200.description: The request was successful and the status data is returned.

GetRegulatoryComplianceStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the status of a regulatory compliance operation as part of a GET request body in JSON format.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method. Clients must include a JWT (JSON Web Token) in the Authorization header when making requests. This ensures that the server can authenticate the client and authorize access to protected resources.
